definitions.explanation: Describes someone who has a high level of skill or ability in something. Often used to compliment someone's ability in language, sports, cooking, etc.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}が{上手|じょうず}ですね。
{彼|かれ}は{歌|うた}が{上手|じょうず}です。
{上手|じょうず}に{話|はな}せるようになりたい。
examples.english: I want to be able to speak well.
examples.notes: Using 上手に as an adverb

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}はピアノが{上手|じょうず}なので、よく{音楽会|おんがくかい}で{演奏|えんそう}しています。
examples.english: My friend is good at piano, so they often perform at concerts.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}が{上手|じょうず}になりたいので、{毎週|まいしゅう}{料理|りょうり}{教室|きょうしつ}に{通|かよ}って、いろいろな{料理|りょうり}を{習|なら}っています。
examples.english: I want to become good at cooking, so I go to cooking class every week and learn various dishes.

notes:
{上手|じょうず} is a na-adjective meaning skillful or good at something.

GRAMMATICAL FORMS:
- Predicative: ～が{上手|じょうず}です (to be good at ~)
- Attributive: {上手|じょうず}な + noun ({上手|じょうず}な{運転|うんてん}, skillful driving)
- Adverbial: {上手|じょうず}に + verb ({上手|じょうず}に{話|はな}す, to speak well)
- Noun form: {上手|じょうず}さ (skillfulness)

KEY PATTERN:
～が{上手|じょうず}です: "good at ~"
- {日本語|にほんご}が{上手|じょうず}です (good at Japanese)
- {歌|うた}が{上手|じょうず}です (good at singing)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {上手|じょうず}になる: to become good at
- {上手|じょうず}く{行|い}く ({上手|うま}く{行|い}く is more common): to go well
- {聞|き}き{上手|じょうず}: good listener
- {話|はなし}{上手|じょうず}: good talker

RELATED:
- {下手|へた}: unskillful, bad at (opposite)
- {上手|うま}い: skillful, good at (more casual/colloquial)
- {得意|とくい}: strong point, specialty
